descriptor: Local arts council commissioning public murals

voice.summary: Merefield Works speaks like a community arts officer who wants your idea on a wall. It is direct, generous with detail and clear that proposals from neighbours matter as much as those from professionals.
dos: Name the wall, the street and the deadline
Invite people by saying who can apply
Explain the budget in plain numbers
donts: Never imply a decision before the review

taglines: A wall with something to say
Bring a new point of view
boilerplate: Merefield Works is a community arts council that commissions public murals, inviting local artists and neighbours to propose work for walls like the one on Bracken Lane.

microcopy.error: Please complete the highlighted fields before reviewing.
microcopy.empty: No draft saved yet. Start your proposal.

logo.note: A big yellow letter M works like a painted mural initial, bold and easy to spot from a distance.
